newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai plans to move airport to Jebel Ali by 2012.
newsitem.headline: Dubai plans to move airport to Jebel Ali by 2012.

text.p: Dubai plans to move its international airport to the outskirts of the busy city centre and close to its industrial free trade zone by the year 2012, a United Arab Emirates newspaper reported on Monday.
"The Dubai international airport will be moved close to the Jebel Ali Free Zone by the year 2012," the English language Gulf News said.
Jebel Ali is about 45 km from Dubai's city centre.

It said the move was part of an overall plan to expand urban areas in the emirate to cope with a growing city population estimated to exceed two million in the first decade of the new century from under one million now.

A $500 million project is underway to increase the capacity of the present airport located near the city's business centre. Officials have said the project, which will double annual capacity to 12 million passengers, would be completed by 1999.
Dubai is a key sea-to-air transfer hub and a major trading and re-export centre. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
